#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll mod_pow(ll x, ll e) {
    ll res = 1;
    for (int bit = 30; bit >= 0; --bit) {
        res = (res * res) % MOD;
        if ((1LL << bit) & e) res = (res * x) % MOD;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p);
        return 0;
    }

    vector<char> visited(static_cast<size_t>(p), 0);
    ll ans = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            visited[i] = 1;
            ++ans;
            ll cur = (static_cast<ll>(i) * k) % p;
            while (!visited[cur]) {
                visited[cur] = 1;
                cur = (cur * k) % p;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << mod_pow(p, ans);
    return 0;
}
